goals.title: Analyze cube.js source
goals.objective: Grep cube.js/packages/{schema-compiler,api-gateway,query-orchestrator} to pin the contract: query object shape, full filter-operator list+SQL, timeDimension granularity/dateRange, /load+/meta+/sql response envelopes, WebSocket subscribe protocol, GraphQL schema. Capture in docs/06-cubejs-contract-notes.md. Cross-check doc 05 sketches.
goals.evidence: docs/06-cubejs-contract-notes.md: query shape, filter ops->SQL, PG measure+granularity, REST routes, WS protocol, response envelope, permission model.

goals.title: Project scaffold
goals.objective: uv project + deps (fastapi, sqlalchemy>=2.0, pydantic v2, pydantic-settings, redis, strawberry-graphql, apscheduler, psycopg[binary], pytest, pytest-asyncio, testcontainers[postgres], httpx). Package layout cubepy/{schema,security,sqlgen,orchestrator,api,cache,config}. Settings via pydantic-settings (.env). Ruff config. Smoke test imports.
goals.evidence: pyproject + package layout + config + FastAPI /readyz; uv sync OK; smoke 2 passed; ruff clean.

goals.title: Schema layer
goals.objective: CubeMeta pydantic model + @cube decorator + MeasureType/DimensionType enums + measure()/dimension()/join() helpers + SchemaRegistry (register/get/all). Support Python-decorator and YAML cube files. Resolve a sample Orders+Users schema. Unit tests.
goals.evidence: schema/{meta,registry,loader}.py: StrEnums, frozen dataclasses, SchemaRegistry, @cube decorator, helpers, YAML loader. 7 schema tests pass (9 total).

goals.title: Permission layer
goals.objective: SecurityContext (pydantic) + from_jwt (HS256) + PermissionBuilder.apply_row_level (securityContext.check_permission returns WHERE fragments) + filter_fields (shown callbacks, cube/measure/dimension/segment visibility). FastAPI dependency: Authorization Bearer -> SecurityContext. Unit tests with roles viewer/manager/admin + multi-tenant.
goals.evidence: security/{context,permissions,auth}.py: frozen SecurityContext + from_jwt (HS256, claim aliases + raw claims), create_token dev helper; PermissionBuilder.apply_row_level (check_permission fragments + role defaults, single-quote-escaped), filter_fields (shown on measures/dims/segments), cube_visible; FastAPI security_context dep (Bearer->401). tests/test_security.py 9 tests (jwt round-trip, invalid token, RLS viewer/manager/admin, injection escaping, field visibility, dep 401/200). 18 total pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: SQL generator
goals.objective: SQLAlchemy 2.0 Core: measures(sum/count/countDistinct/avg/min/max/filtered), dimensions, full filter-operator->SQL table, timeDimensions(date_trunc granularity + relative dateRange keywords like 'last 7 days','this month'), join graph, securityContext WHERE injection, order/limit/offset. PG dialect. Produces compiled SQL string. Unit tests against expected SQL.
goals.evidence: sqlgen/{operators,date_range,query,builder}.py: full filter-operator table (param-bound), dateRange keyword resolver, Query pydantic parse, SQLBuilder->sqlalchemy.text. Measures sum/count/countDistinct/countDistinctApprox/avg/min/max, dimensions, timeDimensions date_trunc+range, joins (lowercase alias, author-case preserved), RLS injection, segments, order/limit/offset, hidden-member fail-closed. tests/test_sqlgen.py 8 tests incl SQLite execution smoke (RLS+filter+aggregate verified). 26 total pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: Query orchestrator
goals.objective: Cache key (hash of normalized query + ctx tenant/user), Redis get/setex with refreshKey.every TTL, PreAggRouter STUB (returns None + logs, seam for later), execute via async SQLAlchemy engine, assemble Cube.js-style response envelope (data, annotation, sql, lastRefreshTime). Unit tests with fakeredis.
goals.evidence: cache/redis_cache.py (async get/setex), orchestrator/{preagg,executor,envelope,orchestrator}.py: PreAggRouter stub seam, AsyncEngineExecutor, build_envelope+annotation (cube.js shape), QueryOrchestrator cache->route->exec->setex, make_cache_key scoped by tenant/user/role (RLS-safe), per-cube refresh_key.every TTL. resolve_member in registry. tests/test_orchestrator.py 4 tests (fakeredis+FakeExecutor: miss/hit, ctx-scoped key, param'd stmt). 30 total pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: REST API
goals.objective: POST /cubejs-api/v1/load, GET /meta, POST /sql, GET /readyz. Authorization: Bearer -> SecurityContext dep. /load -> orchestrator -> JSON envelope. OpenAPI auto. Integration test with TestClient + sample schema.
goals.evidence: api/{app,routes_rest,deps}.py: FastAPI factory with lifespan (lazy AsyncEngine + Redis -> QueryOrchestrator), create_app(orchestrator=) test injection, get_orchestrator dep. Routes POST /cubejs-api/v1/load + /sql, GET /v1/meta + /readyz, all behind Bearer security_context. /load->orchestrator->envelope, /meta filters by visibility, hidden/bad member -> 400. tests/test_api_rest.py 7 tests (readyz, 401 no-auth, /load envelope, /sql, /meta visibility, 400 hidden/bad). 37 total pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: WebSocket subscribe
goals.objective: /cubejs-api/v1/subscribe. Accept WS, read {token, query, refreshKey.every}, poll server-side at refresh interval, hash result, push only on change, handle cancel/close. Integration test drives a refresh and asserts a pushed update.
goals.evidence: api/routes_ws.py: /cubejs-api/v1/subscribe WS endpoint implementing cube.js protocol (auth frame -> method:subscribe -> server polls refreshKey.every -> pushes on data-hash change -> unsubscribe cancels). orchestrator.load(use_cache=False) for subscribe so changes aren't masked by warm cache. Per-conn send_lock + asyncio task cleanup on disconnect. tests/test_api_ws.py 3 tests (bad-auth close, first push, push-only-on-change). 40 total pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: GraphQL (Strawberry)
goals.objective: Schema mirroring REST: Query.cubes(args where/orderBy/limit) returning typed members from registered cubes. Reuse orchestrator+security. Integration test with strawberry test client.
goals.evidence: api/graphql.py: Strawberry schema with Query.load(query: JSON)->QueryResult{data,lastRefreshTime}, GraphQLRouter context_getter wiring security_context+orchestrator deps, mounted at /cubejs-api/graphql. Reuses orchestrator+RLS. tests/test_api_graphql.py 2 tests (typed rows via JSON var, auth required). 42 total pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: PG integration tests + sample schema
goals.objective: Sample Orders+Users schema + seed SQL. testcontainers Postgres (fallback: localhost:5432 if CUBEPY_TEST_PG_DSN set). End-to-end: /load with measures+timeDimensions+filters, /meta, subscribe refresh, GraphQL query. Verify generated SQL executes on real PG and returns correct aggregates.
goals.evidence: samples orders_schema+seed.sql; conftest testcontainers PG; test_integration_pg.py 7 tests green; Decimal/datetime JSON-safe coercion; README updated. All 10 stories complete, full quality gate passed.

goals.title: Calculated measures
goals.objective: Add MeasureType.CALCULATED with a formula referencing sibling measures ({name}). SQLBuilder inlines referenced measures' aggregate SQL into the formula (MVP) e.g. {revenue}/{count} -> sum(amount)/NULLIF(count(*),0). Update schema decorator/loader + /meta. Unit tests (SQL shape) + PG integration test (revenue per order correct).
goals.evidence: MeasureType.CALCULATED + formula; SQLBuilder._calculated_sql inlines {name} refs (non-recursive, unknown/nested -> ValueError); sample avg_order_value; SQL+PG tests. 52 pass.

goals.title: Dynamic GraphQL schema
goals.objective: Per-cube typed GraphQL schema: Query.<cube>(where, orderBy, limit) exposing measures/dimensions as fields, built dynamically from the registry. Resolver maps selected fields -> Query -> orchestrator. Keep JSON load() fallback. Integration test selecting specific members returns correct aggregates.
goals.evidence: api/graphql.py rewritten: per-cube typed fields generated dynamically (type()+strawberry.type), member selection drives the query, node instances hold row as plain state; load(query:JSON) fallback retained. build_graphql_router() called at create_app. { orders { revenue status } } verified inline + unit (typed rows) + PG integration (shipped 40/pending 5). 54 pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: refreshKey.sql / updateWindow
goals.objective: Extend cache invalidation: cube refresh_key.sql probe (result-hash cached at short TTL) invalidates the result cache when it changes; updateWindow bounds staleness. Orchestrator checks probe before serving cached results. Unit test with fakeredis proving probe change invalidates.
goals.evidence: orchestrator._probe_signature: refresh_key.sql probe cached at updateWindow TTL; on cache hit, mismatched probe sig invalidates (delete + re-exec); updateWindow<=0 forces fresh probe each check. RedisCache.delete added. test_orchestrator: probe-invalidates-on-change (data_calls 1->2 on probe change, stays 1 when unchanged). 55 pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: Concurrent-query dedup
goals.objective: Orchestrator in-flight map cache_key -> asyncio.Future; on a cold miss, if a query is already in-flight, await its result instead of re-executing (thundering-herd protection). Pop on completion/failure. Unit test: N concurrent identical cold queries -> executor invoked exactly once.
goals.evidence: orchestrator: _inflight cache_key->asyncio.Future; cold miss awaits in-flight future instead of re-executing; future resolved/errored + popped in try/finally. _execute extracted. test: 5 concurrent identical cold queries via asyncio.gather -> executor called once. 56 pass, ruff clean.

goals.title: queryType multi + compareDateRange
goals.objective: /load accepts queryType:'multi' with query:[q1,q2,...] -> returns [envelope,...] preserving order. compareDateRange: timeDimension.dateRange=[r1,r2] expands to per-range sub-queries via multi. Tests: multi-query returns N envelopes; compareDateRange returns per-range breakdown.
